description:
List the countries, ID formats and official sources Fuentio covers. Free, no key.
Use it first when unsure whether a country or ID format is supported, or to explain coverage. Don't use it to check a company: call lookup_company or search_companies.
Inputs: none. Example: list_coverage().
Returns: per country, status (available or planned), coverage level, ID formats with real examples and whether lookup works, regional registers, and sources with licence and update frequency.
Limits: 0 units. Read-only. Covered today: France, Spain and United Kingdom.
Search words: company registry, KYB, SIREN, RCS, Annuaire des Entreprises, société; BORME, Registro Mercantil, empresa, sociedad; Companies House, company number, Ltd, plc, LLP.
name: list_coverage
title: List covered countries and ID formats
